# Civilian factory allocation.
#
# Both windows hang off countryconstructionsview, the construction panel's
# root in vanilla interface/countryconstructionsview.gui, so their positions
# are in that panel's coordinates.
#
# wif_cg_goods_overlay repaints the consumer goods row. The engine's own
# number there now always reads 1 (see the header of
# common/scripted_effects/wif_civilian_allocation.txt), so the row shows the
# RECOMMENDED number instead - what consumer goods need to break even - with
# the current balance beside it and the arrow that opens the window.
#
# It cannot be parented to the row itself. The first version tried
# parent_window_name = static_consumer_goods_entry; that is a template the
# engine copies into the construction list, the name never resolved, and the
# overlay fell back to the top-left corner of the screen. So it sits on the
# panel at the row's position instead, and does NOT follow the list if the
# construction queue is scrolled.
